Try a practice Directions

Your first practice

What to bring

Nothing specialized. Come ready to move, learn and meet the team. We will show you around, run you through the basics and answer every question you have about armour, safety and where the sport can take you.

Athletic clothes

Comfortable gear you can move and sweat in.

Indoor shoes

Clean runners with decent grip.

Water & the venue fee

Bring enough water for an active practice.

Protective cup

Optional at first, useful once contact work begins.

How training works

Your path into armour

No rush and no expectation to compete. You move forward when you are ready.

I

Fundamentals

Movement, balance, falling safely, conditioning and basic weapon handling.

II

Contact

Learn clinch work, grappling, pressure and safe striking mechanics.

III

Soft kit

Add timing, tactics, teamwork and more realistic weapon work.

IV

Steel

Start armoured training once your skills, conditioning and equipment line up.

V

Your choice

Compete, join demos, focus on melee or duels, or simply keep training with the team.
